title: AOSP Engineer
description: Neat is an exciting and fast-growing leader in video conferencing. We are a preferred partner of both Zoom and Microsoft Teams. We design, build and develop top quality Android-based devices for the video conferencing industry, along with our Neat Pulse cloud back-end for our customers to manage their devices. Neat was established by some of the most respected and experienced leaders in the industry to deliver simple, thoughtful communications solutions for people working together in a hybrid world. Your Competence/experience Experience with building and debugging Android platforms Proficiency in C/C++ and / or Java/Kotlin, code. Experience with Android IPC (Binder, HwBinder) Experience to Android Security Concepts (App Permissions, SELinux) Experience with developing and / or interfacing with Android HALs and/or AIDL Experience with Gitlab CI/CD Qualities We Are Looking For People who are willing to delve through the Android Middle layer and are not afraid to touch both Apps and Kernel interfaces Eager to learn new things, willing to figure it out Driven to build high quality, engaging experiences in a highly competitive environment Passionate. We love what we do, you should too Track record with AOSP, including hands-on development with the framework and successful delivery of at least one full Android platform or component. Founded in 2019, Neat was created to make the meeting space the best it can be. We understand the meeting space better than anyone else and we pour all our energy into every last detail of what we do.
